main_text.p: stituit, hinc eminùs per clamores non intelligitur:Ex Theatro etiam ac Suggestu non percipitur, nisi ab exercitatis pronuncietur, qui ufu didicerunt vim aliquam ultimis syllabis, licet eas corripiant, impartiri. Excandescit crebris his lacessitum ictibus Latium: & cum convitio: Da, si potes, exlex & barbara Regulas quæ te dirigunt: etiamnum in incude Grammatica tua, nec prodit: & ut vides, desperant, qui in hoc unum tam impensè desudant artifices: Quid exteros invidiosè traducis? quid miri, nunquam bene disci, quod doceri non potest? Irrumpit adversùm istæc cum furore Belgium: Quid? Sed ne ludrica vertantur in serium, finis esto Luctæ. Ecce quia Gymnasta sum, deponunt cæstus,& obediunt.

page.notes: The page is printed in roman type with long s rendered as s throughout. The catchword "Quæ-" is taken from the foot of the text block. Show-through and the neighbouring page's fragments on the right edge are omitted. The first line was read as "stituit", with the text beginning mid-sentence.
